_about: Charles Dickens's (1812-1870) five Christmas books, as the relay asked: A Christmas Carol (1843), The Chimes (1844), The Cricket on the Hearth (1845), The Battle of Life (1846) and The Haunted Man (1848). His novels sit on other shelves (adler_shelf.json holds some); this shelf is only the Christmas books. Clean Gutenberg text; public domain.

dickens-christmas-carol: A Christmas Carol in Prose; Being a Ghost Story of Christmas (1843)
dickens-chimes: The Chimes: A Goblin Story of Some Bells that Rang an Old Year Out and a New Year In (1844)
dickens-cricket-on-the-hearth: The Cricket on the Hearth: A Fairy Tale of Home (1845)
dickens-battle-of-life: The Battle of Life: A Love Story (1846)
dickens-haunted-man: The Haunted Man and the Ghost's Bargain: A Fancy for Christmas-Time (1848)

_excluded.dickens-duplicates: other transcriptions of the five books: A Christmas Carol (PG 9696, 19337, 19505, 20673, 24022 ill. Rackham, 30368 the manuscript facsimile), The Chimes (9738), The Cricket on the Hearth (9739, 20795, 37581), The Battle of Life (9694, 40723), The Haunted Man (9713)
_excluded.dickens-not-his: stage adaptations by others: C. A. Scott's Old Scrooge (40729), C. Z. Barnett's The Miser's Warning (41739)
